text_block_list.text:
The stands of Hanshin Racecourse are
filled with
lively discussion after the
Asahi Hai F.S. ends.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Was Фудзи Кисэки incredible or what? I
think she
might be the best in her
generation!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
No doubt about it. All eyes'll be on her
once she
starts her classic year!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
I really hope she manages to become a
Triple
Crown Champion!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
Once Фудзи Кисэки finishes changing, I
check the
location of our
accommodations, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Miss Фудзи Кисэки, congratulations on your

excellent performance today!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text: An eager-looking reporter runs up to us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We can't wait to see how you'll do in the
future!
Could I get a few comments from
you?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
It's great that she's so excited, but I
don't want
her to stress out Фудзи Кисэки
with her sudden
questions.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
I'm sorry, but please arrange any interviews
through the school fir—

text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Trainer. There's something I
actually
want to say to the world.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'm all ears!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
"If upon receiving unconditional love
one's heart
is freed from its shell, then
they will strive
tirelessly to become
others' light."
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Someone told me that long ago, and it
came to
mind during today's race.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I heard everyone's cheers of support.
They
allowed me to aim for victory,
wholeheartedly
and single-mindedly.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your love. Please look
forward to
the moment I claim the
Classic Triple Crown!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
How was that? Good enough for an
article, I
hope?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: That was perfect! Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'm excited to see what you'll
write.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Also, I can't always take impromptu
interviews
like this, so please seek
permission from my
school first next
time, okay?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: O-oh! Right, of course!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text: Good! Take care now.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки's gentle gaze must be too
potent for
her because the reporter
turns bright red before
running off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The next morning, while we're en route
to the
academy...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there are already articles about
me! They
must have really fast writers.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The articles she finds online are
accompanied by
expertly shot pictures
of her and rather
passionate reports of
her race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Let's see... "Фудзи Кисэки Charms Crowd
with
Stupendous Performance at Asahi
Hai F.S. and
Forges On with Gratitude."
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
"Next Year's Star Confirmed." Ahaha!
They made
me sound so cool! This is
great!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
A lot of people in the comments have
high
expectations for me as well! How
wonderful!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: So, what race should we tackle next?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: How do you feel about the Yayoi Sho?

text_block_list.text:
Great, considering I was going to
suggest the
same!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to prepare for the Satsuki
Sho by
running a 2,000-meter race on
the big stage, you
see.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки was able to show the world
just what
she's made of in the Asahi Hai
F.S.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But I want her to aim even higher and
run even
harder at the Yayoi Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
